answer: Mooring bond: each identity moors a barge on the ridge by the orchard, locking 70 credits. Each epoch it sails the river with a fresh-serial ticket for one harvest. The ridge ledger binds post, ticket and key; an auditor replays it, and a reused ticket or shared post burns the bond; rented rings gain nothing. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once, keeping bond and share.
